rationale.ai-review: Multiple LLM agents independently detect and compare code vulnerabilities.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Auditor-facing explanations, comparisons, mappings, and reports support human judgment.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Findings are mapped into NIST and OWASP-aligned audit evidence.
rationale.framework: Reusable multi-agent RAG architecture integrates analysis and regulatory reporting.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and tested an interactive web-based prototype.
rationale.expert-validated: Two security auditors and two UX specialists reviewed the contribution.
rationale.general-code: The reviewed repository is vulnerable code, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-security: The system detects, classifies, explains, and reports software vulnerabilities.
rationale.method-self-report: Auditors and UX specialists supplied qualitative feedback on usability and relevance.
rationale.method-experiment: Validators completed assigned DVNA analysis tasks under prescribed conditions.
